rule: published artifacts stay byte-identical; corrections are appended

entries.old_statement: zeta_outer = 0.3691 / 0.4270 / 0.3935, reported with a declared cut rule as though declaring it made the value cut-independent
entries.corrected_statement: Declaring a free parameter is not the same as showing what it does. Sweeping the outer cut from 50 to 95 percent moves zeta by 0.123 (BTC), 0.040 (ETH) and 0.091 (SOL) -- 6 to 17 times the estimator's own standard error of 0.007 -- and the profile is non-monotone (BTC falls to 0.365 at 70 percent then rises to 0.488 at 95).  Every zeta_outer, in either lane, must carry that span.  A parameter-FREE alternative exists and was run: the asymptotic local slope of the full curve, which passes the same linear null (1.001-1.007) and recovery (bias -0.014 to -0.024, stable across psi).  It gives 0.3726 / 0.4401 / 0.4077 de-biased, agreeing with the 75 percent cut to within 0.008 -- so C-T31's NUMBERS happen to be fine, but its claim to them was not earned.  A-S30's 0.416 and 0.439 are reachable inside the sweep; its SOL value of 0.495 is NOT (the sweep's maximum is 0.475), so that one gap is not explained by the cut.
